mu_name: A pebble falling from the ceiling
mu_name_from: MODEL_DUNGEON_STONE01, Data/Object2/DungeonStone.bmd, loaded for the Dungeon and the Lost Tower (MapManager.cpp:53-54). Not a placement: the 29 hidden Object53 markers throw it (ZzzObject.cpp:3874-3879), so it is named in tools/cook.py's TRAP_MODELS and drawn by game/world/trap_show.h.
why_this_one: Eight triangles of stone about 6 cm across, 0.6 to 1.3 scale: the grit that trickles from the Dungeon's ceiling, one frame in three at each marker (ZzzEffect.cpp:2875-2882, MoveHandlers.cpp:4875-4888).
sheet_from: Data/Object2/, the Dungeon's own masonry sheet.
sheet_materials_from: As the walls it falls from.
